TermTranslation.definition: Treatment and support to relieve symptoms and improve quality of life for people with a serious illness that cannot be cured.

TermTranslation.term: châ chî miywâyimuhâkiniwit âkâ shâsh chî wîchihâkiniwit
TermTranslation.term_syllabics: ᒑ ᒌ ᒥᔻᔨᒧᐦᐋᑭᓂᐎᑦ ᐋᑳ ᔖᔥ ᒌ ᐐᒋᐦᐋᑭᓂᐎᑦ
TermTranslation.public_note_en: to make someone comfortable when there’s no ways to help anymore
